definition: ֵבּלְאשַׁצַּר proper name, masculine ( Bêl-šar-uƒur , Bel, protect the king COT Dan 5:1 ) Dan 8:1 represented as king of Babylon, successor, and apparently son of Nebuchadrezzar ( Dan 5:1 ; Dan 5:2 ; Dan 5:11 etc.); in cuneiform inscription known only as prince, son of Nabonidus (last Shemitic king of Babylon), see COT 1.c.
